initialize.instructions:
Purpose: drives a CS2 game client for play and tests: console, input, game state, screenshots, test scripts, servers, demos. It is not the map editor (that is the Hammer server).

First call: session_status. It names the flavour and the available tool groups. WineTools (Windows build with the bridge) has input, console_exec, game_state, game_rules, entity_find, checkpoints and render_world. LinuxClient (native, headless) has no bridge, so only bridge-free tools (console_tail/console_wait, screenshot, observe, server_up/client_connect). Nothing running: launch_session first.

Intent: if the user asks a question, answer it with read-only tools (annotations carry readOnlyHint) and change nothing. Launch, input and console tools only when asked to act.

Traps:
- console_exec never accepts quit, exit, disconnect, Test_ExitProcess or crash; end a session with stop_session.
- Sessions are capped (GPU memory): TooManySessions and KindBusy name the container to reuse or stop.
- Waits return pending:true with `next` when the budget ends: call again, do not loop on a short timeout. BridgeBusy: another call holds the bridge; wait for it.
- Do not send console commands during a level load.
- Judge a test on console.log lines, game_state values or screenshots.
- Errors: read next, useInstead, didYouMean, retrySafe (false = it may have run: check state before repeating). Switch on the error type, not the code. NotImplemented with data.missing: nothing was sent.

Never step outside the tools: if a task needs something no tool does, tell the user and stop.

Done means: the session is the right flavour and map, the action ran, the result is read back (game_state, entity_find, console_tail or a screenshot) and reported as evidence, and a session you launched is stopped with stop_session.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Runtime + flavour + bridge + build + liveness + tool-group availability; never raises.

tools.name: launch_session
tools.description: Start a CS2 container: linux-client (headless), wine-tools (host X, -tools, bridge) or wine-client (Windows client, no -tools). Not for: dedicated servers (server_up). map stages a harness and parks the player (wine-tools). Check mapVerified (false + mapNote: map not confirmed); reused:true = an identical running session. wine-client: bridge tools only once a map runs.

bridge.description: wine-tools: false stops the wait at MenuReached

connect.description: host:port. linux-client: not working; wine-tools: use client_connect

map.description: wine-tools: e.g. de_dust2, editor/zoo/smartprop_zoo; MapLoadFailed if not in game on it in ~10 s

testscript.description: wine-tools: existing suite <app>/vtest/<name>.txt; not with map

waitFor.description: default: MenuReached; BridgeHello for wine-tools; Parked with testscript

tools.name: wait_session
tools.description: Wait for a launched session's readiness stage.

tools.name: stop_session
tools.description: Stop and remove a session container (cs2mcp-* only). pending: true when the stop outlasts the budget (call again).

tools.name: console_tail
tools.description: Last N lines of a console.log, optional regex filter. File: --console-log, else session, else the one running cs2mcp-* session.

session.description: cs2mcp-* container; required when several run

tools.name: console_wait
tools.description: Wait for a new console.log line matching a regex (lines after the call starts, unless fromStart).

fromStart.description: also search the existing file; not with since

since.description: cursor from console_tail or an earlier observe (console.cursor); not with fromStart

tools.name: console_exec
tools.description: Queue a console command through the bridge (-testscript or -tools sessions; not during a level load). Not for: cvar reads (cvar_get); dedicated servers (server_console_exec). Refuses quit/exit/disconnect/crash/maps. confirm: true waits until the engine processed it and returns warnings (its 'Unknown command:' lines: a typo shows up there). A timeout is not retry-safe.

tools.name: game_tick
tools.description: Current server tick and input-hook frame count.

tools.name: cvar_get
tools.description: Read console variables (found, value, type, default, flags). Not for setting: console_exec `<name> <value>`.

tools.name: checkpoint
tools.description: Fire a test-script checkpoint. Checkpoints arriving during Test_Wait are dropped; use Test_WaitForCheckPoint barriers.

tools.name: input_set
tools.description: Press/release/tap virtual buttons and set the view-angle override. Not for: teleporting (setpos); timed multi-step input (input_sequence). While an angles override is set, console setang is ignored.

angles.description: [pitch, yaw, roll] override; null clears it, absent leaves it

frames.description: hold length for tap, with tap only

press.description: buttons held until released (forward, back, jump, duck, attack, use, reload, ...)

turn.description: relative to the active override; not with angles

tools.name: input_clear
tools.description: Release every virtual button and disable the angle override.

tools.name: run_testscript
tools.description: Stage a CTestScriptMgr suite (library name or inline script) and launch a wine-tools session with -testscript. Returns {runId, ...} at once; poll test_wait. Not for: in-game assertions (game_test). suite and inline are exclusive.

inline.description: script text; ';' splits lines, `mark <name>` is a checkpoint barrier

tools.name: test_status
tools.description: State of a run_testscript run: running|passed|failed|error, checkpoint timeline, artifacts once finished.

tools.name: test_wait
tools.description: Wait for a run to finish, then return test_status; pending: true when still running.

tools.name: demo_record_start
tools.description: Start a SourceTV recording. tv_enable 1 must be set BEFORE the map loads; this does not reload the map.

tools.name: demo_record_stop
tools.description: Stop a SourceTV recording; returns the host .dem path and bytes.

tools.name: demo_to_video
tools.description: Turn a demo in csgo/ into a video with the engine encoder (a wine-tools run_testscript; poll test_wait).

demo.description: stem or host path of a demo directly in csgo/

tools.name: server_up
tools.description: Launch a headless Linux dedicated server (RCON, host network) on map (default de_dust2) and port (default 27015; PortInUse when bound). Not for: clients (launch_session). Returns rconPassword (random if absent).

hibernate.description: false: the server keeps ticking when empty (the bridge needs it)

tools.name: client_connect
tools.description: Send `connect <address>` to a client session. wine-tools only; on linux-client use launch_session {connect}.

tools.name: server_console_exec
tools.description: Run one console command on a dedicated server over RCON. Not for: client commands (console_exec). Refuses quit/exit/disconnect/sv_shutdown (use stop_session).

tools.name: script_run
tools.description: Run the scripts of a compiled addon map: launch or reuse the session, fire entry, match the expect regexes in order over the [cs_script] console lines. passed false is a result, not an error; passed null = budget cut (pending). Only kind cs_script, needs addon (source/path: NotImplementedYet). Passes when every expect matched in order and no script error line.

expect.description: regexes in order over whole lines (`MM/DD HH:MM:SS [cs_script] text`)

tools.name: game_test
tools.description: Declarative in-game test. The session must be on spec.map (else launched); setup, steps, spec expect, teardown (always runs). Step {tool, args?, label?, expect?}; tool: round_start, setpos, game_snapshot/restore, input_sequence, fire_weapon, look_at, use_entity, ent_fire, console_exec/wait, game_wait, game_state, weapons, sounds_drain, demo_record_start/stop, checkpoint. Assertion {path (e.g. totals.distance), op: eq|ne|lt|le|gt|ge|approx|contains|matches, value (or {"$ref": "label.path"} into an earlier step), tolerance?, from?: result|game_state|weapons}. Stops at the first failing step unless continueOnFailure; a step result with pending: true or passed: false fails unless asserted on.

verbose.description: false: passing steps carry no result

tools.name: game_test_results
tools.description: Stored results of this process's game_test runs: all or one by name. format junit returns {xml}.

tools.name: render_world
tools.description: Offscreen freecam render of the loaded map (wine-tools bridge). Not for: the player's view (screenshot).

tools.name: game_state
tools.description: Local player: map, tick, view angles, origin/eye/velocity, health, flags, active weapon.

tools.name: weapons
tools.description: Local inventory: active weapon and every held weapon (entindex, name, defIndex, clip1/clip2/reserve).

tools.name: radar
tools.description: Players (team, alive, health, origin, eye yaw, spotted), bomb and hostages, projected onto the map overview.

tools.name: game_rules
tools.description: Round and warmup state: warmup, freeze, team intro, restart, game phase, rounds played, round times and win status, bomb planted. A null field did not resolve (see schemaMissing).

tools.name: entity_find
tools.description: Find entities in the RUNNING game by class (designer name) and/or name (targetname). Not for: the Hammer document (hammer-mcp). Returns entindex, class, name, origin, angles, health, toggleState; truncated:true when more matched. Needs class or name; max 1..256.

tools.name: select_weapon
tools.description: Select a weapon without keypresses. One of: slot 0..13 (slot1 primary, slot2 pistol, slot3 knife, slot4 grenades, slot5 C4), command, weapon (designer name; weapon_knife matches any knife), defIndex or handle (from weapons).

tools.name: sounds_drain
tools.description: Drain recorded game sound events (name, source entindex, origin). Empties the ring (256; dropped counts overflow); installs the hook on first use.

tools.name: sounds_status
tools.description: Install the sound-event sink (idempotent) and report ring counters. mode: wrap (default), listener, both.

tools.name: game_wait
tools.description: Wait until a predicate over the local player holds. until: tick (ticks past the baseline), moved (distance from the baseline origin), stopped (speed < 1), weapon (activeWeapon name or defIndex), at (origin within tolerance 2 xy / zTolerance 4, optionally view angles; speed < 1), roundLive (no warmup, freeze, team intro, restart or winner; player alive), roundRestarted (a new round began, then roundLive), ammo (clip1 moved by clip1Delta on the baseline weapon). A timeout (default 5000 ms) is WaitTimeout, retry-safe.

angles.description: until at: [pitch, yaw, roll]; roll ignored

clip1.description: until ammo: baseline clip count (with entindex)

clip1Delta.description: until ammo: change from baseline; negative = at most (default -1)

tools.name: fire_weapon
tools.description: Shoot: per shot, release then tap attack until clip1 drops by one, then check the shot sounds. Refused before sending (PrerequisiteFailed): wrong weapon, no clip (knife), clip1 below shots. A timeout is not retry-safe (shotsFired says how far it got).

tools.name: look_at
tools.description: Aim the view at a point or an entity (entindex) and wait until it is within 1 degree. hold false (default) then clears the override and reads the view back (snappedBack: true if it moved over 1 degree).

target.description: [x, y, z] point, or an entindex (1..16383)

tools.name: use_entity
tools.description: Use an entity: aim, press use, wait 32 ticks, re-read it. Refused (PrerequisiteFailed) when farther than maxDistance (64) from the eye: setpos near it first. ok is true only with evidence: use sounds, an origin/angles change, or the slot emptying.

target.description: [x, y, z] point, or an entindex (1..16383)

tools.name: ent_fire
tools.description: Send `ent_fire <target> <input> [value] [delay]` through console.exec and confirm the engine ran it; the effect is NOT verified (read it back). target * is refused; Kill/KillHierarchy on a wildcard or classname target needs allowDestructive.

allowDestructive.description: for Kill/KillHierarchy on a wildcard or classname

tools.name: setpos
tools.description: Teleport the local player (setpos_exact/setang_exact), then wait until it is at origin and stopped. floor true: origin.z is only an upper bound (FellOutOfMap past 512 u or below minZ). Refused while an input.set angle override is active (input_clear first). Once sent, errors are not retry-safe.

angles.description: [pitch, yaw, roll]: pitch +-89, roll +-180; roll not compared

floor.description: z is only an upper bound: the player may fall

minZ.description: with floor: a lower landing is FellOutOfMap

tools.name: input_sequence
tools.description: Run up to 32 input.set steps in order. Each step takes the input_set fields and holds holdTicks game ticks (default 1, max 640). Presses persist across steps until released; tap frames are client frames. Not for: a single press (input_set). input.clear is sent at the end and on error. ToolBudgetExceeded (retry-safe) when the steps cannot fit the call budget. An error after the first input.set is not retry-safe.

steps.description: run in order; each takes the input_set fields

angles.description: [pitch, yaw, roll] override; null clears it, absent leaves it

frames.description: hold length for tap, with tap only

press.description: buttons held until released (forward, back, jump, duck, attack, use, reload, ...)

turn.description: relative to the active override; not with angles

tools.name: game_snapshot
tools.description: Save the local player (pose, velocity, health, armor, money, team, weapons) and the round summary under name (32 at most, in this process). export: true also writes artifacts/snapshots/<name>.json.

tools.name: game_restore
tools.description: Restore a snapshot on the same map: pose, health, armor, missing weapons, then the active weapon. Returns restored, comparison, notRestored; armor/helmet removal and extra weapon copies cannot be fixed. Refused: another map or team. Once sent, errors are not retry-safe.

name.description: exactly one of name or snapshot

snapshot.description: inline snapshot in the game_snapshot form

tools.name: round_start
tools.description: Put the round in a known state (idempotent). mode ensure (default): no-op on a live round; a dead player, no team or a round winner restarts; in warmup it ends the warmup; else waits for roundLive. mode restart: mp_restartgame 1. Refused cvars (map changes, exec/alias/bind, mp_restartgame, mp_warmup_*, host_*, quit) are InvalidParams. Once queued, errors are not retry-safe.

cvars.description: extra cvar -> value, sent before the warmup end or restart

tools.name: ocr
tools.description: Extract text from the last capture (last: true) or a host PNG with tesseract.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the game view: the next frame the session presents, from its Vulkan swapchain via the capture layer. Returns the host PNG path (full size) and an inline image. Needs a session launched with capture (the default). Not for: a render without the player (render_world).

tools.name: observe
tools.description: One playtest observation: screenshot, console.log tail or lines since a cursor, checkpoint events, game.tick, a screen guess (dialog|loading|unknown). Each part fails independently into errors[].

image.description: inline | small (<= 640 px) | none; the file is full size
